column1: # Per-release guest code addresses the port uses (PPU EBOOT). Keyed by the BCES00052 1.00 address.
# eu: BCES00052 1.00 (EU)   na: BCUS98127 (NA disc 02.00, APP_VER 01.00)
# kind: fn = function entry, ret = return address (follows a call), call = call site, code = other address in a function
# role: name of a hook (a function the port wraps or replaces); empty for plain references
# Generated and checked with tools/tod-fnmap: `check elf/na/EBOOT.ELF <list> --steps 10200:0,274F8:30,39D400:230,3B8998:258,5AD700:280`
# (every fn is a function start in the NA ELF and in its lift; ret/call words are calls; 154 direct calls between
# mapped functions agree with the map). Data addresses (0x840000.., 0x10000000..) are the same in both and not listed.
